texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]出大事了！研究结束后并无重大发现，船员便返回到船上，却发现[From.GetPlanetMoon]的某只猛兽竟然跑上了船！

该生物已经杀害了一位船员，并正在撕毁墙壁试图逼近其他的船员们。他们撑不了多久！已经发布一个特殊项目去救人了。
texts.en:
Catastrophe has struck the [Root.GetName]! After conducting their studies, with no interesting finds, the crew returned to the ship only to find it carrying a beast from the [From.GetPlanetMoon]! 

The creature has already killed a crew member and is trying to claw itself through the walls to get to the others. They won't last long at this rate! A Special Project has been issued to save the ship.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]发生了大灾难！在进行研究而一无所获之后，船员们返回飞船时却发现上面有一只来自[From.GetPlanetMoon]的有机体猛兽！

这只猛兽已经瘫痪了一个船员单位，且正在撕毁墙壁试图逼近其他的单位。这样下去他们活不长了！拯救舰船的特殊项目已经发布。
texts.en:
Catastrophe has struck the [Root.GetName]! After conducting their studies, with no interesting finds, the crew returned to the ship only to find it carrying an organic beast from the [From.GetPlanetMoon]! 

The creature has already rendered one crew member unit inoperable, and is trying to claw itself through the walls to get to the others. They won't last long at this rate! A Special Project has been issued to save the ship.

texts.zh: 我们的救援队成功击毙了[From.From.GetName]上的那只猛兽。科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]和船员们都受到了惊吓，但依然能够胜任各自的职务。他们非常感激士兵们的援救，这件事激发了人们参军的热情。
texts.en: Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the team are rather traumatized, but assure that they are still fit for duty. Their appreciation of the soldiers saving them goes viral and we can already see a boost in new enlistees.

texts.zh:
我们的救援队成功地消灭了[From.From.GetName]上的猛兽。科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]及其团队只受到了轻微的损伤，并仍可执行任务。武装单元成功排除有机威胁的行动引起了机械合成工厂对于机械安全的广泛重视。

因此，我们的作战单元的建造速度以及动机软件的有效性已有所提高。
texts.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the team have sustained negligible damage, and are still fit for duty. The success of our armed units in dispatching the organic menace has roused renewed focus among the assembly yards responsible for their construction.

As a result, we are noting an increase in combat unit build-speed and motivation software effectuality.

label.en: A proud day for the navy!
A proud day for the navy!

texts.zh:
我们的救援队成功击毙了[From.From.GetName]上的那只猛兽。可惜他们没能及时拯救科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]，后者为了保护船员们而阵亡了。

至少飞船无损，船员们很快就可以恢复工作。我们的母星沸腾了，都为我们的士兵们的英勇行为点赞。
texts.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Sadly they didn't make it in time to save Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] who died while trying to protect the crew.

At least the ship is intact and the crew says they can go back to work soon. Our homeworld becomes abuzz about our military's bravery in handling the situation.

texts.zh:
我们的救援队成功地消灭了[From.From.GetName]上的猛兽。不幸的是，他们未能及时拯救试图保护船员而受到了致命损伤的科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]。

至少舰船依旧完好无损，而船上其它单位表示他们很快就能恢复正常机能。我们母星主控电路正忙于升级军事相关算法以更好的应对未来可能发生的类似事件。
texts.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Unfortunately, they didn't make it in time to save Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName], who took terminal damage while trying to protect the crew units.

At least the ship is intact and the crew informs us they can resume normal functions soon. Our homeworld's circuits are abuzz with updates on our military's efficacy in handling the situation.

texts.zh:
被怪兽侵袭的飞船发来了最后的电报。那些野兽已经成功突破到了船员藏身的地方。

情况太过残忍，就不多做描述了。没有生还者。
texts.en:
A last transmission has been received from the monster-infested ship. It tells us that the beast succeeded in getting through to the crew's hiding place.

The horrid encounter was far too graphic to describe. There were no survivors.
